canonical_project: STT GDC Meerkhanpet AI-ready data centre campus
owner: STT GDC India (ST Telemedia Global Data Centres)
notes: MoU signed with Telangana government on 21 Jan 2025 for a new AI-ready campus on the outskirts of Hyderabad at Meerkhanpet/Mucherla (Rangareddy district), targeting up to 100 MW with up to Rs 3,500 crore investment; part of STT GDC India's 1 GW pan-India vision.
